title: 第3章 一脚废了他第4章 你好大的胆子
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 银发女子瞥了秦云一眼，然后说道：“你可要考虑清楚了，吸收吞天神脉并不能保证成功，如果失败了，后果会很严重。”
“会死吗？”
秦云问道。
“当然会。”
银发女子点了点头。
“与其平庸活一世，不如搏一把，就算是死我也认了。”
秦云咬了咬牙，对银发女子说道：“来吧！”
银发女子玉手一挥。
太古封神殿的两扇青铜古门缓缓开启。
左侧一扇闪烁着璀璨的光芒，如同白昼；右侧一扇是深幽无比的黑暗，如同暗夜。
吞天神脉从里面飞了出来。
秦云看着它，不由紧张起来。
瞬息间。
吞天神脉已经贯穿了秦云身体。
伴随着撕裂的剧痛，秦云原本的经脉破碎了，然后吞天神脉逐步替代了原本的经脉。
这个过程痛到了极致。
秦云终于明白了，为什么以前被吸收力量的时候会有非人的痛苦和折磨了，一切都是为了今天做准备。
如果没有三年来的折磨。
自己早在吞天神脉入体的那一刻就已经痛得晕死过去了。
吞天神脉融入后。
秦云的血肉和骨骼开始蠕动，从最初的疏松变得紧密起来，并且越来越坚硬，五脏六腑也在增强。
咔咔的声音从体内传来。
秦云的肩膀延展开来，匀称的身体线条逐渐呈现，身材比例逐渐达到了完美的程度。
秦云发现整个过程，就像是传说中的脱胎换骨一样。
蜕变结束后。
秦云试着运转体内真气，结果震惊了。
真气瞬息循环上万次……
林淮月觉醒血脉之力的时候，真气也就从瞬息一百次提升到了六百次的程度而已。
仅仅整个变化，加上修为的提升，林淮月就登上了洛城地榜第三十八位了。
自己瞬息循环上万次。
那不是足以登临洛城地榜第一位了？
银发女子眸子透着无法抑制的意外，竟然融合成功了？
她从未想过秦云会成功融合吞天神脉。
因为在这之前已经失败上千次了，纵使是天资超绝的生灵也一样难逃失败的结果。
秦云是上千位被选中者天赋最差的一个。
要不是太古封神殿选了秦云的话，她连试都不想让秦云试。
谁能想到，秦云竟然成功了。
“既然你已经成功融合吞天神脉，那么你现在就可以吞噬灵药来提升修为了，你修为越高，吞天神脉的作用就越强。”
银发女子说道。
秦云连忙取出一株七品灵药。
content_en:
The silver-haired woman glanced at Qin Yun, and then said: "You have to think carefully. Absorbing the Heaven-Devouring Divine Vein does not guarantee success. If it fails, the consequences will be serious."
"Will you die?"
Qin Yun asked.
"Of course."
The silver-haired woman nodded.
"Instead of living a mediocre life, it is better to give it a try. Even if it means death, I will admit it."
Qin Yun gritted his teeth and said to the silver-haired woman: "Come on!"
The silver-haired woman waved her hand.
The two ancient bronze doors of the Taikoo Temple opened slowly.
The one on the left shone with bright light, like day; the one on the right was filled with deep darkness, like the dark night.
The Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein flew out from inside.
Qin Yun looked at it and couldn't help but become nervous.
In an instant.
The Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein has penetrated Qin Yun's body.
Accompanied by the severe tearing pain, Qin Yun's original meridians were shattered, and then the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Veins gradually replaced the original meridians.
This process was extremely painful.
Qin Yun finally understood why he experienced inhuman pain and torture when he was absorbing power before. Everything was to prepare for today.
If it hadn't been for three years of torture.
The moment the Devouring Heaven Divine Vein entered his body, he had already fainted from the pain.
After the integration of Tiantian Divine Veins.
Qin Yun's flesh, flesh and bones began to squirm, becoming tighter and harder from the initial looseness, and his internal organs were also strengthening.
A clicking sound came from inside the body.
Qin Yun's shoulders stretched out, his well-proportioned body lines gradually emerged, and his body proportions gradually reached perfection.
Qin Yun found that the whole process was like a legendary rebirth.
After the transformation is over.
Qin Yun tried to circulate the true energy in his body, but was shocked by the result.
The true energy circulates tens of thousands of times in an instant...
When Lin Huaiyue awakened the power of her bloodline, her true energy had only increased from a hundred times to a level of six hundred times.
Just with the entire change and the improvement in cultivation, Lin Huaiyue climbed to the 38th place on the Luo City rankings.
I cycle through it tens of thousands of times in an instant.
Isn’t that enough to reach the first place on the Los Angeles City rankings?
The silver-haired woman's eyes showed uncontrollable surprise. The fusion was successful?
She never thought that Qin Yun would successfully integrate the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein.
Because it has failed thousands of times before, even the most talented creatures cannot escape the result of failure.
Qin Yun is the least talented among the thousands of people selected.
If Qin Yun hadn't been chosen by the Ancient Conferred Temple, she wouldn't have even wanted to let Qin Yun try.
Who would have thought that Qin Yun would succeed.
"Since you have successfully integrated the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein, you can now consume the elixir to improve your cultivation. The higher your cultivation level, the stronger the effect of the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein."
The silver-haired woman said.
Qin Yun quickly took out a seventh-grade elixir.
